name: Taylor-Made Movies / Movie Room

sourceOfTruth.label: TaylorMade Movies repository
sourceOfTruth.rule: All Codex, GPT, plugin, and skill work for this project references this repository and its main branch as the source of truth. System-managed plugins and skills remain in their managed directories and are not copied into this project.

providerBoundary.jellyfin: Local metadata, title matching, seasons, episode organization, posters, backdrops, and descriptions. Jellyfin is not the viewer-facing app.
providerBoundary.onedrive: Cloud-resident video playback plus synchronized .jellyfin.json sidecars and artwork stored beside each video.
providerBoundary.movieRoom: The viewer-facing web and Fire TV front end. It reads the OneDrive catalog and sidecars; it does not copy media into Jellyfin.

verificationGates: The full test suite reports zero failures; the Windows POSIX-permission test may remain skipped.
The production alias responds successfully and repeated authenticated /api/library reloads return the catalog from cache without waiting for a full Graph refresh.
The live catalog count and metadata/artwork counts are checked together before claiming deployment complete.
No password, session secret, refresh token, API key, cookie, or personal secret is stored in this blueprint.
